references.text: The same instruction that Aaron's sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar, which applies to the cattle offering
The guilt offering shall also be slaughtered in the same place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and the blood shall be sprinkled around on the altar
The sin offering shall be slaughtered before the Lord's presence in the same place as the burnt offering
The instruction to slaughter the ox before the Lord at the entrance of the tent of meeting
The blood from the ram shall be sprinkled around on the altar, the same ritual practice
Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar for the peace offering, the same procedure
Ezekiel describes that the burnt offering table is on the north side of the altar, corresponding to 'צָפֹנָה' (northward)
The tables for slaughtering offerings in the temple were placed on the north side
The letter to the Hebrews refers to the sprinkling of blood on the tabernacle and all vessels used in the service
Illustrates that the pouring out of blood around the altar is a standardized procedure for all peace offering animals.
Confirms that the ritual for the lamb as a peace offering follows the same pattern of blood pouring as the burnt offering.
Shows the historical fulfillment of the instruction regarding blood pouring in the consecration ritual.
Confirms that the instruction for the peace offering's blood pouring was observed in the consecration ritual.
